test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 16 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A cylindrical rod has an curved surface area of 4,900 cm² . If the length of the rod is 97 cm, then the radius (in cm) of the rod, correct to two places of decimal, is: (Take pi = (22)/(7))
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Curved Surface Area (CSA) = 2 × π × r × h

4900 = 2 × (22/7) × r × 97

r = (4900 × 7) ÷ (2 × 22 × 97) ≈ 34300 ÷ 4268

r ≈ 8.0365...

**∴ The correct answer is 8.04 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Curved Surface Area (CSA)** of the **cylindrical rod** = 4,900 cm²

**Length (Height)** of the rod (h) = 97 cm

Value of π = 22/7

**Formula Used:**

CSA of a cylinder = 2πrh

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/acfc20d87e7f5a336398acfe9ddd054202895a25421605a0bc0fc46471511f2a.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ 4900 = 2 × (22/7) × r × 97

⇒ 4900 × 7 = 44 × 97 × r

⇒ 34300 = 4268 × r

⇒ r = 34300 ÷ 4268

⇒ r = 8.03655...

⇒ r ≈ 8.04 cm (rounded to two decimal places)

**∴ The correct answer is 8.04 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Total Surface Area of Cylinder

The sum of curved surface area and the area of two circular bases: TSA = 2πr(h + r).

Volume of Cylinder

The capacity of the cylindrical rod: Volume = πr²h.

Base Area

The area of the circular cross-section of the rod: Area = πr².</p
